quarterly_data.signal: Ciena's 10-Q: remaining performance obligations were $2.5 billion as of August 1, 2026 (fulfillment timing can be impacted by supply conditions), and outstanding purchase order commitments to contract manufacturers and component suppliers for inventory were $3.3 billion, including advanced orders for certain long lead time components (only a portion of this amount is firm, non-cancelable and unconditional). Citing orders significantly exceeding revenue and an industry-wide constrained supply environment that has resulted in historically high backlog, Ciena says it has entered, and is seeking to continue to enter, multi-year supply agreements with certain suppliers, some involving firm purchase commitments and prepayment arrangements, and long-term purchase arrangements with customers.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $2.5 billion; purchase order commitments $3.3 billion (as of August 1, 2026)
